newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down on London's fall, adjustment.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down on London's fall, adjustment.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down three cents at 14.72 ringgit ($5.92) a kg, reflecting a lower London Metal Exchange (LME) close overnight, traders said.
They said there was also a price adjustment after the recent gains. "The price had gone up in the last three days and some adjustment is needed," said one trader.
Turnover was 126 tonnes, down from 201 on Wednesday. Buyers were again from Japan, Europe and Malaysia.
The local price premium over LME narrowed to $20 a tonne against $55 previously.
